G'day, we're Chloe and Tyler

We come from hospitality and the military, and we've taken on a much-loved part of the Wollongong food scene. Our job is simple: serve Wollongong the best American BBQ experience around.

Same smoker, same iron bark, same no-shortcuts barbecue. Over the coming months we're making Barrels more sports friendly, with games on the screens and nights built around the sports calendar. And the truck is still bringing the BBQ all over the Illawarra and beyond.

Chloe and Tyler
